extras: Beer and wine are available at an additional charge

Optional island-wide pickup: a car carries up to 5 guests for USD 75; a van carries up to 9 guests for USD 125 per van. All adults, children and infants count toward capacity. Groups above 9 need transport reviewed by the team. Pickup is one hour before arrival/check-in, in Curaçao local time.

policies.cancellation: DEMO POLICY - REPLACE BEFORE GO-LIVE: Cancel or request a change at least 48 hours before departure. Later cancellations and no-shows are non-refundable in this demonstration.
policies.safety: DEMO POLICY - REPLACE BEFORE GO-LIVE: Participation is at the guest's own risk and instructions from the captain and crew must be followed. This demonstration does not state or verify insurance coverage.
policies.insurance: Insurance coverage is not verified in this demonstration. Mermaid must approve final insurance wording before go-live.

en.pickup_pending: Pickup from {location} is requested, not confirmed. Its price and collection time still need confirmation; pickup is not included in the trip amount.
en.confirm: Does that look right? You can confirm in your own words or tell me what to change.
en.booking_complete: Your booking is complete with Mermaid. Your receipt is attached.
en.pickup_payment_note: Pickup is still pending; this payment covers the trip only.
en.pickup_priced: Pickup from {location} at {pickup_time}. Please be ready then. {currency} {amount} for your whole booking, anywhere on Curaçao, included in this total. The quoted vehicle price includes pickup and the return to your accommodation.

en.pickup_requires_review: Your group needs more than one pickup vehicle. Mermaid's team will need to confirm the transport and price.
en.pickup_awaiting_guest_count: I need the full guest count, including children and infants, to price the pickup.
en.contact_phone_prompt: What's the best number to reach you on, including the country code? It's for important trip updates, like a weather cancellation.
en.contact_phone_retry: Could you send the full phone number with its country code, starting with +? I need that to save a reachable contact for trip updates.
